name: insight-explore
description: Explore possible implementations before committing, targeting three distinct options while reporting evidenced constrained or unresolved outcomes honestly. Trigger when the user runs /explore or asks to "brainstorm options", "what are the ways to do this", "explore approaches", "give me alternatives", or wants divergent thinking before planning or assessment. Use insight-assess to evaluate known options, insight-critique to review an existing output, and plan-create to turn a chosen direction into an implementation plan.
